newsitem.title: UK: HORSE RACING-PITMAN SPLITTING FROM MOTHER TO TRAIN ON HIS OWN.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-PITMAN SPLITTING FROM MOTHER TO TRAIN ON HIS OWN.

text.p: Assistant trainer and former top jockey Mark Pitman said on Monday he was splitting from his mother Jenny to set up in his own right.
Pitman , who in 1991 rode Garrison Savannah to Cheltenham Gold Cup victory for his mother, made the decision after a weekend family meeting.

He said: "My mother has known for some time that I wanted to go on my own and she made it quite clear to me that she will continue to train for the foreseeable future. I have got a place in mind that I want to train from and I hope to be in within four weeks.''
Pitman retired from the saddle in 1993 to become assistant to his mother. He is the son of former jockey Richard Pitman, who is now a television commentator.
Jenny Pitman has a host of big race winners to her credit, including Burrough Hill Lad and Garrison Savannah in the Gold Cup and Corbiere and Royal Athlete in the Grand National.
